summary: oplmusic_hosttest.c, resolv_hosttest.c and ish_hosttest.c with ten faults in private copies of Doom's music code in ports/doom, utils/resolv.c and ish/; the test runs all three

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host ${WORK}/t/tests/musl ${WORK}/t/ports && cp -R ish utils ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ports/doom ${WORK}/t/ports/ && cp tests/host/oplmusic_hosttest.c tests/host/resolv_hosttest.c tests/host/ish_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/tests/host/ && cp tests/musl/ishmusl.c ${WORK}/t/tests/musl/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/ports/doom -I ${WORK}/t/ports/doom/src -DNORMALUNIX -Wno-implicit-function-declaration ${WORK}/t/tests/host/oplmusic_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/ports/doom/i_oplmusic.c ${WORK}/t/ports/doom/midifile.c ${WORK}/t/ports/doom/mus2mid.c ${WORK}/t/ports/doom/opl3.c ${WORK}/t/ports/doom/src/memio.c -o ${WORK}/oplmusic_hosttest && ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all ${WORK}/t/tests/host/resolv_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/resolv_hosttest && exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -DISH_USE_STDLIB ${WORK}/t/tests/host/ish_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/ish/ish_shell_utilities.c ${WORK}/t/ish/ish_cstring_utilities.c -o ${WORK}/ish_hosttest
s=0; for t in oplmusic_hosttest resolv_hosttest ish_hosttest; do ${WORK}/$t || { r=$?; [ $s -ne 0 ] || s=$r; }; done; exit $s

faults.name: midi-first
faults.summary: the first channel read of a MIDI event takes a byte with its top bit set

lines: channel parameters must be seven bits

faults.name: midi-second
faults.summary: the second channel read of a MIDI event takes a byte with its top bit set

lines: channel parameters must be seven bits

faults.name: genmidi
faults.summary: a GENMIDI lump too short for its instrument table is taken

lines: a truncated instrument table is rejected

faults.name: dns
faults.summary: the resolver does not connect its socket, so a foreign reply is taken

lines: a foreign reply cannot decide resolution

faults.name: redirection
faults.summary: output redirection to descriptor 0 is taken as no redirection

lines: output redirection lost a standard descriptor

faults.name: environment
faults.summary: HOME and PATH are matched without their equals sign, so a prefix matches

lines: home matched a prefix or a different case

faults.name: environment-case
faults.summary: environment names are matched without regard to case

lines: home matched a prefix or a different case

faults.name: tempo
faults.summary: the tempo product is computed in 32 bits and overflows

lines: tempo preserves the expected sample duration

faults.name: tempo-minimum
faults.summary: a tick of less than one sample is not raised to one

lines: tempo preserves the expected sample duration

faults.name: loop

lines: the boundary replays the delta-zero note
